The system shall automatically maintain the status of a change request:
Draft - the default state when created
In Review - the state where the change request is in review by the approvers
Approved - the state where the change request has been approved by all reviewers
Implementation - the state where the change request has pending Implementation Task(s)
Closed - the state when an approved change request has been fully implemented by doc control

The system shall automatically update the status attribute of all documents/parts on the approval request when the state of the approval request changes:
Pending Change when the AR is in Draft State
In Review when the AR is in In Review State
Approved when the AR is in Approved State 
Approved when the AR is in Implementation State
Released when the AR is in Closed State

The system shall allow a user trained on an MPI to access any LHR that uses that MPI until Redlines are made to the MPI
The system shall automatically add users trained on an MPI to the operators list
The system shall allow an Enlil authorized employee to create a new company
The system shall allow the user to add in a Company Name, Company abbreviation, Company Admin email, Company Avatar and Logo as part of the company details
The system shall allow the user to customize whitelabelling for the new company
The system shall require the user to add a Document Approval Matrix that will be used in the newly created Company
The system shall require the user to set up the Landing page for different modules in the newly created company
The system shall require the user to set up the navigation menu for the newly created company
The system shall allow the user to add a list of employees and contact information
The system shall allow the user to add a list of GL codes to match the financial system of the newly created company
The system shall allow the user to add template documents for the forms requested to be used in the company
All form documents created during company creation will remain in the Draft state in the newly created company
The system shall maintain a data log created during company creation listing all the events that have occurred during the process
The system shall allow the creation of clearly identifiable and unique test companies in preparation for the final company release
The system shall allow the authorized user to configure Start number, Prefix for document, and labelling for Enlil items.

The system shall allow the user to define PI parameters by adding the description in free text to represent Equipment or Materials. These parameters will be defined later in the LHRT that uses that PI.
The system shall indicate when a Material or Equipment is parameterized in the LHR Template
The system shall allow the user to release the LHRT only after the required parameter selections have been made
The system shall allow the owner to make Redlines to the LHRS after the LHRS is Started and before the LHRS is Completed.

Sub-Module: Selecting Material Lots and EQ items at the LHR
Requirement: The system shall allow the user to pick Equipment and Lots for Material at the LHR
The system shall provide a mechanism for the company admin to enable a collaborative cloud based storage environment for a particular company. One account will be supported per company.
The system shall provide a mechanism to allow users to connect a Collaborative Cloud based Storage environment when access is granted by the company admin

Enlil shall grant read/write access and save a copy of the Enlil item while they are in the unreleased (WIP/Draft/ Pending change) state on the company connected to a Collaborative Cloud based Storage environment

The system shall grant "read only" access to the a Collaborative Cloud based Storage environment folder of the corresponding Enlil item when it is in the (IN_REVIEW) state. Anyone with access to the a Collaborative Cloud based Storage environment folder, and any added approvers, can view this folder while it is in the IN_REVIEW state.

When the Enlil item is in WIP/ Draft/ Pending change state, any edits made to an existing attachment or any new additions made to that a Collaborative Cloud based Storage environment folder associated with that item, are synced back with Enlil

When the Enlil item is in WIP/ Draft/ Pending change state, any newly added or removed attachments in the Enlil item, are synced back with the associated Collaborative Cloud based Storage environment folder
The system shall delete Collaborative Cloud based Storage environment folders associated with Enlil items once they are released on Enlil
The system shall delete folders associated with voided Enlil items from a Collaborative Cloud based Storage environment

Sub-Module: Internal types supporting the export feature
Requirement: The system shall provide a mechanism to export Enlil items (with internal type OTHER, PART_LOT, RECORD, EQUIPMENT, LOT) in a printable format
The system shall maintain a timestamp on the printable format to indicate when it was exported
The system shall assign a unique ID for each printable version
The system shall allow the user to export a printable version per revision of the supported Enlil item to the requestor's email.
The system shall allow files including the pdf of the Enlil item upto a total size of 10mb to be added to the printable version
The system shall add a watermark to the Enlil item for Draft, Obsoleted and Superseded versions

The system shall send a printable version including all attachments, and a summary of the revision history (where applicable) of the supported Enlil item belonging to the Document group to the requestor's email.
The system shall display a list of Released parts for LHR
The system shall display a list of all parts for EB
A Receiving record created in the system shall follow the Record lifecycle
The system shall not generate a LOT number for items received agaist a service
The system shall allow the user to preview the PO
The system shall release the PO in numeric stage
The system shall attach the AR as a separate PDF while exporting a printable version including all attachments, of the supported Enlil item belonging to the Record group
